perspectives.summary: Remote homelab main has MetaMCP at latest, no server registry in Git, and existing live kubeconfig default is Unauthorized. The worktree includes OIDC/ExternalSecrets support and a Prometheus MCP deployment, but no authoritative Loki/Tempo/Kubernetes/Argo/GitHub registrations.

Codicarium is Synced/Healthy on MetaMCP 2.4.22 with public API mcp.codicarium.com and internal VPN UI. Its live registry has GitHub-p (44 tools), GitHub-p_Actions (4), Kubernetes (20), ArgoCD (16), and Prometheus (6), but no Loki or Tempo entries.

Upstream normal release v2.4.22 is current as of 2026-08-20; MetaMCP supports /mcp Streamable HTTP and OAuth metadata/PKCE. OpenAI requires public HTTPS, protected-resource discovery, authorization-code PKCE S256, and exact ChatGPT redirect handling.

The current homelab desired state contains mutable tags and a historical plaintext Better Auth value; UI OIDC does not prove MCP OAuth. Completion requires secret-safe references, explicit target checks, protocol tool-call evidence, and rollback proof.
Treat this as a security-gated, multi-lane implementation. Do not copy unknown credentials or substitute absent server definitions; preserve the environment target boundary and record blockers.

consensus_summary: Proceed with a GitOps-first, secret-safe homelab implementation only after resolving the authoritative Loki/Tempo implementation and restoring authorized homelab Kubernetes/Argo access. The Codicarium database is a sanitized reference for the two GitHub servers and the existing Kubernetes/Argo/Prometheus tool counts, not a source for cross-environment infrastructure targets.
